findings.description: The KMS key used for the audit trail bucket does not set enable_key_rotation = true, so the key material is never automatically rotated. Long-lived key material increases the impact of key compromise and violates common compliance baselines for audit log encryption keys.

No policy attribute is specified, so AWS applies the default key policy that delegates full kms:* access to the account root, allowing any IAM principal in the account that has KMS permissions to use or administer the key that protects audit logs. An explicit least-privilege key policy should restrict who can encrypt, decrypt, and manage this key.
